subject: general
question: Copper and zinc are melted together in the ratio 11 : 9. What is the weight of meled mixture, if 27 kg of zinc has been consumed in it?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Ratio of zinc in the copper and zinc mixture = 9over20

Let the total weight of the melted mixture be "a" kg.

According to the question-

⇒ 9over20 × a = 27 kg

⇒ a = 27 × 20over9 = 60 kg

**∴ The weight of the melted mixture is 60 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** The ratio of copper and zinc could be expressed as-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d0a5ea94e08252e51b3e3c8abb3b2a120bfb90616a81f0d7c2ef9741f3fcb79.png] 

Hence, the total weight is 60 kg.
